svg.text: Barista & Shift Lead | Fairview Networks Holdings

text.tspan: I used to handle this badly. I prepped onions
and sauces on Sunday so Tuesday had a chance.
What changed is simpler than it sounds.
Sharing food with friends fixed a rough week
more than I expected.
Feeding people is a love language that still
needs a grocery list.
I needed the reminder myself.
Food is culture, logistics, and comfort in the
same bowl.
I asked the server for the dish they actually
like. Good call.
Support the places that treat staff and guests
with care.
The restaurant owned the mistake, remade the
plate, and checked back once.
Support the places that treat staff and guests
with care.
A farmers market tomato made a plain sandwich
feel special.
Hospitality includes how you recover from
mistakes.
We kept a running list of "easy wins" meals
for drained evenings.
Repeat meals are not failure. They are
systems.

Cleaning as I cook is still a skill I practice
on purpose.
Food is culture, logistics, and comfort in the
same bowl.
Salt earlier. Taste more. Rush less.
